tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nor lha mchod tshul dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo badz+ra pā ṇi ye/ sngon tshe bsod nams tshogs rab mang*/ /rgya chen bsags pa'i 'bras smin pas/ /yo byad nam mkha'i mdzod chen la/ /dbang bsgyur nor lha'i tshogs la 'dud/ /'dir nor lha'i rgyal po rnams la mchod tshul mdor bsdus zhig dang*/ de dag gi bzlas bya'i gzungs sngags dang bcas pa brjod par bya te/ /de yang rang nyid yi dam gang la brten bde'am/ gsang bdag byed na/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ stag gi spags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ auṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra nas badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lam gsum auṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ nas shap+ta ā hūṃ/ rū pa/ nas spar sha āḥhūṃ/ de nas rgyas pa byed pa'i tshe bskyed chog dgos kyang 'dir bsdus pa yin pas spyan drangs nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros lcang lo can sogs rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rgyal chen rnam sras dzam bha la nor rgyun ma la sogs pa nor lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs nor lha'i tshogs/ /'gro ba'i don du brtser dgongs la/ /thogs med 'phrul gyis gshegs su gsol/ /e h+ye hi ma hā ka ru ṇi ka badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen pho brang dbus/ /rgyal chen rnam sras ār+ya dzam bha la/ /nor rgyun ma sogs nor lha yab yum rnams/

/'khor dang bcas pa dgyes bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ /rgya chen bsod nams tshogs kyi sa bon las/ /legs 'khrungs longs spyod 'dod rgu'i dpal brnyes te/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i phongs pa'i sdug bsngal kun/ /zhi mdzad nor lha'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon lnga/ /rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rtags brgyad dang*/ /'bru sman rin chen dar sna gtor tshogs bcas/ /nor lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas mnyes phyir 'bul/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan srog chags 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /gter bum dpag bsam shing chen ri gling dang*/ /nyi zla bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs bcas/ /nor lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas mnyes phyir 'bul/ rnal 'byor bdag cag sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyis/ /re ltos 'cha' ba'i bsam pa shugs drag pos/ /legs par sbyar pa'i mchod tshogs 'di dag kun/ /'bul lo bzhes la 'dod rgu'i dngos grub stsol/ /gzhan yang bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ba'i/ /mchod tshogs ji snyed mchis pa de kun kyang*/ /yongs bsdus nor lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la/ / 'bul lo bzhes la 'dod rgu'i dngos grub stsol/ /mi 'dzad rin chen mdzod la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /'gro kun phongs pa'i 'jigs las skyob mdzad pa/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid nor lha 'khor bcas la/ /gus pas 'dud do dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /khyed rnams mchod bstod bskul bas bdag cag gi /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod don tshe dpal longs spyod dpal 'byor rnams/ /yid la bsam bzhin char ltar 'bebs par mdzod/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pas nor lha'i tshogs/ /thams cad dgyes bzhin tshur byon bdag nyid kyi/ /snying gar zhugs nas byin brlabs rjes bzung ste/ /skye kun mi 'dzad gter la longs spyod shog /zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ /yang na/ de ltar gsol bas nor lha'i tshogs dgyes te/ /thugs kyis dgongs bzhin rang gi gnas su gshegs/

/badz+ra muḥ/ mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /dge ba 'di yis zhes sogs brjod cing bsngo smon bya'o/ /nor lha mchod cing gzungs 'di rnams bzlas na tshe rabs kun tu nor lha rnams kyis rjes su 'dzin cing longs spyod can du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel yod par bshad pas so so'i sngags dang thun mong gi sngags rnams las dang po ni/ /auṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swāhā/ auṃ dzam bha la dzā len+d+ra ye swāhā/ auṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya swāhā/ auṃ pūr+ṇa bha dra ya swāhā/ oṃ dha na dā ya swāhā/ auṃ ki li mā li ni swāhā/ auṃ pi tsi kun+ḍa li swāhā/ auṃ mu khen+d+ra ya swāhā/ auṃ tsa ran+d+ra ya swāhā/ rnams yab dang*/ auṃ ba su dha ri ni swāhā/ auṃ tsan+d+ra gan+t+ye swāhā/ auṃ dān+ta ya swāhā/ auṃ su dān+ta ya swāhā/ auṃ ār+ya ye swāhā/ auṃ su bha dra te swāhā/ auṃ gup+ta ye swāhā/ auṃ de bai swāhā/ auṃ swa ra swa t+yai swāhā/ rnams yum gyi sngags so/ /yang dzam bha la'i sngags/ na mo ār+ya dzam bha la ye/ tat+ya thā/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ e h+ye hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ me sna dha ya swāhā/ tat+ya thā/ pū ta ne pū ta ne/ su ru me su ma te/ su na te su pū sh+ye/ hi li mi li swāhā/ yang*/ na mo ār+ya dzam bha la/ ma hā dzam bha la/ tat+ya thā/ si mi si mi/ su mu su mu/ tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa/ tsa ra tsa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ sa da ya da ma la ma na da ma/ anan+te dan+to sa ha/ ār+ya dzam bha la swāhā/ dha na dā ya swāhā/ ma no ta tha pa ri pū ra ka swāhā/ yang*/ na mo ma ṇi bha dra ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/

auṃ hrīṃ hrāṃ k+sha dz+riṃ hrīṃ hrāṃ/ di byarat+nau)ga pa ti sha na a ta bā ka de ba yak+ṣa sa ma ya ma nu masma ra hrūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa rnams bzlas na lags so/ /zhes pa 'di ni/ dad stobs ldan pa'i brag sne'i dge slong dge 'dun dpal bzang zhes bgyi bas 'di lta bu zhig bris na rang gi lag gis dad pas bar du brko bar bya'o zhes bskul ba'i ngo bor bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o/ /mad+ga laṃ/ /bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/nor lha mchod tshul dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 68--PAGE 69--PAGE 66-
